name: Rocket Propellant Chemistry
summary: The thermochemistry, properties and handling of liquid, solid, hybrid and electric-propulsion propellants, treated conceptually.

Materials compatibility, toxicity and safe handling of propellants
Propellants for electric propulsion (xenon, krypton, iodine)
